Cannot merge with current main: two files conflict. No code defect was found in the tested trial merge.

The input checks, separate healing bound, and strict kerf checks on both planes look correct. The new tests cover corners, fillets, slots, invalid values, and both widening modes.

Local build and test results:

The PR was trial-merged with main at `3970d3d0319e423761c48f9a7e0a6391a14b9403`. No runner was used.

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` | 660 steps passed; 0 failed |
| Quick test totals | motion: 470 passed; app: 3995 passed; post: 712 passed |
| `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main` | All reached motion and app heavy lanes ran; 217 steps passed; 0 failed |
| Heavy test totals | motion: 56 passed; app: 42 passed |
| Registered known-failure checks | Both failed at the expected assertions; the gate accepted both results |
| `cargo clippy -j 6 -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings` | Passed |

Extra suites run:

No extra fixture or importer suites were required. This diff changes no fixture, golden directory, or import code. The quick gate also ran `camcraft-app --test feature_edge_g1_join` and the wire integration suites.

Safety mutation checks:

- Disabled the `heal_tolerance` input check. `zero_heal_tolerance_preserves_existing_refusals_and_door_rejects_bad_values` failed with exit 101.
- Replaced the healing upper bound with infinity. `excesses_above_heal_tolerance_refuse_with_spot_depth_and_bound` failed with exit 101.
- Restored both edits. All six `wire_edm::ruled_heal_tests` passed. No mutation edit remains.

No goldens moved. No UI file changed, so before/after screenshots were not required.

Required before merge:

1. `crates/motion/src/wire_edm/mod.rs:355`: Resolve the test-module conflict with current main. Keep both the healing tests and main's preimage tests.
2. `crates/motion/src/wire_edm/ruled_widen.rs:36`: Resolve the import conflict with current main. Keep the healing report and main's preimage behavior. Run the gates and lint again after the branch refresh.

Main changed during the local checks. A final merge simulation against `06d349391` found these conflicts. The green results above apply to the tested main snapshot, not to a resolution of the new conflicts. The PR stays a draft with the `conflicts` label.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Addressed:

1. Resolved the `wire_edm/mod.rs` conflict. Kept both the healing and preimage test modules, each under `#[cfg(test)]`.
   Both pin names appear in test discovery. Removing the healing module failed the discovery check. Removing the preimage test module failed compilation. Restored discovery passed.
2. Resolved the `ruled_widen.rs` import conflict. Kept the healing report and preimage behavior. Removed obsolete imports.
   Existing behavioral pins cover this merge:
   - `tight_inside_corners_heal_within_heal_tolerance`: disabling per-ruling healing failed with exit 101. Restoring it passed.
   - `per_ruling_arc_length_sews_an_asymmetric_trimmed_fillet_as_a_fan`: replacing preimage sewing with the old pairing failed with exit 101. Restoring it passed.

These conflicts changed declarations and imports only. The existing pins cover both retained behaviors, so no new test was needed.

Merged `upstream/main` at `cced2e6fd`. Only the two reported files needed conflict resolution. All mutation edits were restored.

Validation on the new head:
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: 581 steps passed; 0 failed.
- `cargo clippy -j 6 -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed.

New head: `51da4cb016d077c84e977e22516f6f5b8407d948`.

Please re-review this head. The PR remains a draft. No labels were changed.

Needs one description change before merge. No code defect was found.

The two earlier findings are resolved. The test declarations retain both the healing and preimage modules. The imports retain both behaviors. The local trial merge has no conflict.

The input checks, separate healing bound, and strict kerf checks on both planes look correct. The tests cover corners, fillets, slots, invalid values, and both widening modes.

Local build and test results:

The PR was trial-merged with upstream main at `be3729d6b53bf76672d070ffc4a05b4c7363fb4c`. No GitHub runner was used.

The quick plan included extra UI and tooling checks because the trial merge was not yet committed locally. Those checks also passed. The heavy plan used the recorded local trial merge and selected only this PR's 10 changed files.

Extra suites run:

No extra fixture or importer suites were required. This diff changes no fixture, golden directory, or import code. The quick gate ran `camcraft-app --test feature_edge_g1_join`: 5 passed. It also ran the wire integration suites.

Safety mutation checks:

- Disabled the `heal_tolerance` input check in `ruled.rs`. `zero_heal_tolerance_preserves_existing_refusals_and_door_rejects_bad_values` failed with exit 101. After restoration, it passed.
- Replaced the healing upper bound with infinity in `laws.rs`. `excesses_above_heal_tolerance_refuse_with_spot_depth_and_bound` failed with exit 101. After restoration, it passed.
- After both restorations, all six `wire_edm::ruled_heal_tests` passed. No mutation edit remains.

No goldens moved. No UI file changed in the PR, so before/after screenshots were not required.

Required before merge:

1. PR body, line 47 (`Not exercised`): Replace the statement that the heavy lanes were not exercised. Add the completed motion and app heavy-lane results to `Tests`. Current upstream `AGENTS.md`, under `Heavy lanes at review`, requires the body to name the lanes that ran. The results above provide the evidence. This requires a description update; no code change is requested.

Upstream main advanced during the tests. A final merge simulation against `76186e5c4fb5f75b374be0f66b56fca495aa4e4a` was clean. The upstream rules did not change. The test results above apply to the tested main snapshot.

The PR remains a draft with `needs-rework` until its description records the required heavy results. The earlier `conflicts` label is no longer needed.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Addressed:

1. Updated the PR description to record the completed motion and app heavy lanes under `Tests`.
   The latest review records 218 steps passed, zero failed, 56 motion tests passed, and 42 app tests passed.
   The description names the tested upstream commit and links the review evidence.
   `Not exercised` now lists the full batch gate and full release gate.

Evidence: a temporary description check failed on the original body and passed on the corrected body.
Restoring the original body failed again. Restoring the corrected body passed again.
No code change was requested or made. No new commit was needed.

Validation on the unchanged head:
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: 581 steps passed; zero failed.
- Motion: 481 tests passed; 10 ignored. App: 3996 tests passed; 43 ignored.
- `cargo clippy -j 6 -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed.
- Plain push returned `Everything up-to-date`.

Head: `51da4cb016d077c84e977e22516f6f5b8407d948` (unchanged).

Please re-review this head and the corrected description. The PR remains a draft. No labels were changed.

Ready for the maintainer to merge. No blocking finding remains.

The later `Addressed` comment permits this review of the unchanged head. The description now names the completed motion and app heavy lanes. It links the earlier results and removes the incorrect heavy-lane exclusion. This resolves the previous finding.

The earlier conflict fixes also remain correct. Both healing and preimage test modules remain registered. Both behaviors remain in the widening code. The trial merge is clean.

The input checks reject negative and non-finite healing bounds. Both widening modes check both planes. The emitted path retains strict kerf checks. Existing callers use `heal_tolerance: 0.0`. The tests cover bounded healing, refusal above the bound, uncut-rest notes, and separation from twist tolerance.

Local build and test results:

The trial merge used upstream main at `5fdbed9bd8e7a8bb28e6f162a02ab423842b77e8`. No GitHub runner was used.

|---|---|

| Quick test totals | Motion: 481 passed; app: 4004 passed |

| Heavy test totals | Motion: 56 passed; app: 42 passed |

| `cargo clippy -j 6 -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings` | Passed |

Extra suites run:

No additional fixture or importer suite was required. The diff changes no fixture, golden directory, or importer code. The quick gate also ran `camcraft-app --test feature_edge_g1_join` and the wire integration suites.

Safety mutation checks:

- Disabled the `heal_tolerance` input check in `ruled.rs`. `zero_heal_tolerance_preserves_existing_refusals_and_door_rejects_bad_values` failed with exit 101.
- Replaced the healing upper bound with infinity in `laws.rs`. `excesses_above_heal_tolerance_refuse_with_spot_depth_and_bound` failed with exit 101.
- Restored both edits. All six `wire_edm::ruled_heal_tests` passed, including both mutation targets. The worktree has no source changes.

No goldens moved. No UI file changed, so before/after screenshots were not required. The final merge simulation was clean. GitHub reports `MERGEABLE` on the reviewed head.

Required before merge: none.

The review label is `merge-ready`. The author is mkinney, so this draft will be marked ready as requested.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
